name: Question 4
problem:
Find the missing values in the following truth table:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,B∨(¬A∧¬B)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-1}} |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-2}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-3}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-4}} |
worked_solution:
First, let's add columns for $¬A$ and $¬B:$

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,¬A\,$ | $\,¬B\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |

Then, we add a column for the part of the expression that's in parentheses, $¬A∧¬B:$

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,¬A\,$ | $\,¬B\,$ | $\,¬A∧¬B\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |

Finally, we add a column for $B∨(¬A∧¬B):$

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,¬A\,$ | $\,¬B\,$ | $\,¬A∧¬B\,$ | $\,B∨(¬A∧¬B)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
